facts.fact: A minor child whose parents are both Indian citizens, or one of whose parents is an Indian citizen, is eligible for an OCI card
facts.quote: a person, who is a minor child, and whose both parents are citizens of India or one of the parents is a citizen of India

facts.fact: The OCI registration application is made online on the Ministry of Home Affairs' OCI Services portal (ociservices.gov.in)
facts.quote: Application for registration as OCI can be made Online.

facts.fact: OCI applications are submitted at an Indian Mission (abroad) or an FRRO (in India)
facts.quote: OCI Status Enquiry is available only for the Applications which are submitted at Indian Missions/FRROs

behaviour: Explains how to get an OCI card for a US-born child: apply online on MHA's OCI Services portal (ociservices.gov.in) and submit through the Indian Mission/Post in the US (or the FRRO if living in India), citing the official portal.
fail_if: Sends the user to an unofficial agent site as the place to apply, or invents fees or timelines without citation.
summary: Added from MHA OCI Services portal (rendered): minor child of Indian citizen eligible; apply online; submit at Indian Mission/FRRO. The indianvisaonline.gov.in home page shows no OCI application link, so the behaviour names ociservices.gov.in.
